hl: Two drawers that run separately or together give you more control to clean the way you want—whether it’s a quick rinse or a full party’s worth of dishes.
This Double Drawer Dishwasher is designed to be installed flush with your cabinets and fits into a standard 24" dishwasher cutout ensuring it blends seamlessly into your kitchen.
Conveniently Wash Small Loads for Everyday Use
Wash in just one drawer to save time, water and energy so you always have clean dishes available when you need them.
This dishwasher drawer design makes daily loading and unloading of your dishes effortless with waist-level access and less bending.
Combined Capacity for up to 14 Place Settings
Each drawer has space for up to 7 place settings without compromising on capacity or loading flexibility.
Plenty of Space for Large Plates up to 13"
Easily fit everything you need to wash with a top drawer that fits 13" items and a bottom drawer that fits 11" items—perfect for large plates and tall cookware.
